problem: A guest who taps "request offers" is sent to /login with no return path, and after signing in lands on /dashboard, not on the checkout (the cart survives but the patient must find the way back).
The same missing return path on the server guard: every gated page redirects to bare /login.

While no pharmacy has answered, the offers page only polls every 15 s with the sentence "an empty list does not mean the order was cancelled": no "expanding the search" step, no final "no pharmacy available" state (decision 13), no cancel button.

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: /pharmacy/waiting-for-pharmacy is a redirect to broadcast-status (offers-screen.tsx), whose waiting state has the confirmed cancel for any status; the cancel is now one shared component (cancel-order.tsx) also used on order detail and tracking. Two screens show the same waiting state (/pharmacy/broadcast-status and /pharmacy/waiting-for-pharmacy) and only the second has a cancel button, but it is reached only for status "draft", so the real waiting order can never be cancelled on web (the app has cancel on broadcast-status).

An order that no pharmacy has accepted (ready_for_split, broadcasting) is labelled "قيد التجهيز" (being prepared) in the orders list and as the tracking status, and the tracking timeline starts with "order accepted".

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: tracking shows a "Continue" button to the order's next step (final price, payment, insurance) from the order router. Selecting an offer from broadcast-status sends the patient to /orders/:id/tracking?selectedOfferId=, but the tracking page ignores that parameter and has no "continue to price/payment" button (the app tracking has view.next), so the next step (accept the final price) is a detour through order detail.

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: tracking shows a "Continue" button to the order's next step from the order router. Tracking has no next-step button after an offer is selected (accept price / pay), unlike the app.
Two payment UIs for the same step: inline method buttons on the offers page (OnlinePaymentActions) and the separate /pharmacy/payment page.

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1 (cancel button on order detail and tracking until the order is dispatched; the refund rule text of decision 26 waits for the OC-A policy D-26). No cancel button and no refund rule on the pharmacy order detail or tracking once offers exist (decision 26: cancel before dispatch = full refund incl. delivery); the server already says can_cancel in /unified-bookings/mine.

Checkout offers "دفع مباشر" vs "عبر التأمين" as a toggle per order; decision 30 wants insurance or self-pay chosen at the start of the service and the app checkout has no insurance choice at all, so web and app differ.
After adding a policy from the checkout insurance card the form always returns to /insurance, not to the checkout.

Already fixed: /medicines and /medicine-catalog are permanent redirects to /c (catalogueHref). Three web catalogues: /c (canonical), /medicines (dashboard tile "الأدوية") and /medicine-catalog (wishlist "start shopping"); the dashboard also has "صيدلية" -> /c.
The product page shows a discount badge on prescription-only items (decision 10: no offers, discounts or points on Rx items).
The app product page shows the discount pill on prescription-only items.

Partly fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: the app badge now reads "أونلاين فقط" (six languages); the web badge waits for the public product answer to carry online_exclusive (backend/src/modules/medicines/med-i18n.ts:304 sends is_rx but not online_exclusive). No "أونلاين فقط" (online_exclusive) badge on the web product page (decision 11); the app badge says "حصري أونلاين", a different wording.

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: adding a prescription item shows a notice (addedRxNote, six languages). Adding a prescription item to the cart shows no notice (decision 10); the confirmation line is the same for every item.

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: the buy bar label is now "Reference price" (referencePrice, six languages). The product page buy bar shows a catalogue price total while the cart says the price comes only from the offers.

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: the OCR failure also links to "Request a medicine by name". The prescription upload is gated by OCR: when /ai/prescription-ocr fails (503 here) the patient only sees "could not analyse the image" with no way to continue, skip OCR or enter the medicines by name (only the "unreadable" error links to the manual request).

Fixed on design/backend-fields: the app now stops when the photo gives no medicine lines (RxIntake.tsx), like the web. (was: Web blocks when OCR finds no lines, the app uploads anyway with empty items and shows "no lines" afterwards: the same step behaves differently.)

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: the web cart banner has "Consult a doctor" (opens the specialties list). Cart with an Rx item offers only "upload"; there is no "استشر طبيب" button (decision 10) on the web cart.
Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: the app cart has a "Consult a doctor" row (opens the specialty list). No "استشر طبيب" button in the app cart either (only upload).
Fixed on design/oc-journeys-1: the checkout banner has "Consult a doctor". The "prescription missing" banner at checkout links only to upload, no consult option.
Web and app differ: the web cart goes straight to checkout and uses the "active" prescription, the app cart goes to rx-order to pick a prescription first.
rx-order (web) has no pickup/delivery choice and no insurance choice (the cart checkout has both), and always creates the draft with payment_mode cash.
Insurance is only choosable per offer (coverage radio shown if insuranceReady) for the Rx and manual flows, contrary to decision 30 (choose first).
No "استشر طبيب" button exists anywhere in web or app (decision 10); an Rx cart has no route to a consultation.

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-2: the empty list now offers clear search (or back to consultations). The doctors list ends in "no results" with no action when nothing matches (seed has 0 published doctors).

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-2: an unloadable doctor shows the error state with retry instead of the form. When the doctor cannot be loaded the booking page still draws the whole form under the title "الطبيب غير متاح" (visit type, days, payment, confirm).
The web booking always offers clinic, video and home regardless of the doctor's consultation modes (the app reads consultation_modes).
Home visit asks the patient to type latitude and longitude as text; no saved-address / map picker (the app uses the address book).
A server booking error message is shown raw to the patient (English/code text in ur and ar).

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-2: the booking page shows the cancellation and refund terms before the payment card. No cancellation/refund terms are shown before payment on the booking page (decision 26: the table is shown before payment).
"Book a follow-up" on the summary goes to /consultations/booking-status?followUp=true, which ignores followUp and only shows the status.
"Order the medicines" on the summary goes to the pharmacy catalogue (/pharmacy), not "اطلب الأدوية دي" filling the cart (decision 18).
Web "اطلب الأدوية دي" on the prescription page opens rx-order and broadcasts directly; decision 18 says it fills the cart (the app does).

Fixed on design/oc-journeys-2: the app tells the patient how many hand-written lines were not added to the cart. App "اطلب الأدوية دي" silently skips lines without a catalogue id (hand-written lines), so the cart can hold fewer medicines than the prescription with no message.
Two follow-up entries: /consultations/follow-up (book + chat buttons) and the summary link above; neither passes ?followUp= to the booking.
The web chat thread is an activity-only list (no text, no composer): "chat with doctor" buttons lead to a screen where nothing can be read or sent (decision 24 wants full messaging inside a booking).
The /chat thread list rows have no link, so threads cannot be opened; the page itself says threads cannot be opened.
The /chat list is still reachable from the dashboard ("المحادثات") and used as the fallback of every chat redirect; decision 24 removes it.
Doctor chat can be opened without a booking: the web follow-up/clinic-confirm button creates a direct thread by doctorId and the app push handler opens chat-with-doctor with only a sender id.
App chat composer is text only (no voice note, image or file), no "emergency 997" line, no follow-up window state or "book a follow-up" button (decision 24).
Two cancel UIs on web: the appointment page (cancel with a reason) and /consultations/cancel-reschedule (reached from the list "edit" button) which also has cancel and reschedule.

The web cancel page computes the refund on the page with a hard-coded 24 h / 12 h rule (100/50/0) and shows fixed policy copy; the owner policy is 2 h (100/50/0) with one free reschedule, and refund text must come from the server (the app already reads the server policy).
Cancelling from the appointment page gives no refund amount or method afterwards, only a refresh.
The app shows the server error message raw when a cancel fails.
After a consultation card payment the shared /payments/result has no order id, so "paid" offers only "my orders" (the pharmacy orders list), not the appointment.
Fixed on design/oc-journeys-3: the appointment page shows the server cancellation policy card above the payment block. The consultation payment block has no cancel or refund note.
A finished appointment links to the generic /prescriptions list, not to that visit's prescription or to "اطلب الأدوية دي"; no chat entry or follow-up from the appointment page.
Booking a lab test from the lab list ends at "no lab available" with only a back button (no compatible lab in seed, but also no alternative such as the lab list or the cart).
Two booking entries: "book this package" -> /diagnostics/labs/book and "add to my order" -> /diagnostics/cart (cart -> checkout).
The diagnostics cart takes the test name and price from the URL (?add=&name=&price=) and sums a total from them; "TEST/199" was accepted and shown as the total.
With no lab able to run the tests the cart says "remove a test and try again" even for a single test.
The hub card "استخدم تأمينك / upload your insurance card" opens the bookings list, not an insurance step.
The web lab booking page shows a "report ready" tag but no way to open or download the report (the app opens it via /reports/view-report).
Radiology report rows in "نتائجي" have no link.
Lab result rows are all titled "مختبر" with no test name or date.
There is no "ناقش النتيجة مع طبيب" button (decision 19) in the web or app result screens, and no notification target for it.
Raw test codes ("CBC · blood", "PKG_GENERAL · blood") are printed in the lab list.
The app lab "upload prescription" route redirects to the PHARMACY prescription scan, which then offers to order medicines.

The web home-nursing service page says "read-only, no booking is created from this page" and has no booking button; /nursing/booking redirects to the catalogue. Home nursing cannot be booked on web at all.
The /home-care hub lists /unified-bookings/mine (all kinds), so every pharmacy order appears as a "الخدمة غير متاحة / الحالة غير متاحة" row.
The service duration unit comes raw from the server ("1 hour") and is printed in ar/ur pages.
Two parallel web trees for nursing (/nursing/* and /home-care/*); the dashboard "تمريض" goes to /nursing/catalog but its detail links go to /home-care/services/:id.
Fixed on design/oc-journeys-3: the empty state links to the home-care services. /home-care/providers shows an empty state with no action.

App: if the payment intent fails after the booking is created, the patient gets an alert and is sent to live-tracking of an unpaid booking with no way to retry payment (alert shows the raw server message).
No cancellation/trip-fee text before payment for nursing (decision 26).
The reminder form has no "for whom" field and times are typed as comma-separated text; a family member's reminder cannot be created or edited.
The member page shows the member's medicines read-only, no doses taken/missed and no alert.
No missed-dose alert reaches a family member: backend event medication.missed is never emitted and its two handlers only notify the patient; no client shows such an alert.
The family hub has two "إضافة فرد" links (/family/add and /family/add?tab=invite).
The empty catalogue/search state has no "ask the pharmacies for it" action; the manual request is reachable only from the app cart, the barcode screen, the reorder picker and failed OCR.
The web cart has no "item not found, request it by name" link (the app cart has one).
Three routes lead to the same form (/pharmacy/custom-item, /manual-order, /drug-not-found redirect to /pharmacy/request).
The request form has no photo of the box and no quantity (decision 12 mentions text, box photo and prescription requests).
Offers for a manual request show no "price not verified" state (decision 12) and no way to counter or reject a price except the substitute negotiation.
A 5xx from /submit is shown as "service unreachable, check your connection" (the order was created); the draft stays in the orders list with no offers and no cancel.
Offline, tapping "request offers" in the cart ends on the browser's own error page; the service worker has no fetch handler or offline page.
The payment-result screen is pharmacy-specific: a returned consultation or nursing payment has no order to track.
The web /emergency page hard-codes English labels ("Red Crescent Ambulance", "Unified Emergency (911)", "NABD INSTANT") shown in ar, ur and en, plus Arabic in the en page.
Leftover removed feature: SOS "request an ambulance" and "track the ambulance" (/emergency/sos, /emergency/tracking, /emergency/sos-active) still exist on web.
Leftover removed feature in the app: sos, sos-active and ambulance tracking screens.

The dashboard "all services" list repeats entries: AI twice, emergency twice, nutrition and maternity twice, diagnostics twice (two labels), health twice. Fixed on design/oc-journeys-4: the list no longer repeats entries the service grid and AI card already show.
The dashboard keeps a "المحادثات" (/chat) tile (decision 24 removes the chat list).
In ur the currency shows as the Latin code "SAR" (not a translated symbol).
The /emergency pages draw with inline styles that the page CSP refuses (console errors), so their layout depends on blocked styles.
